risk: A publisher audit finds installs with no proof of purchase
cause: Proofs were never filed with the installs
consequence: A true-up claim and staff time lost to the audit
action: Complete proof-of-purchase-check.csv for the five largest publishers

risk: A renewal notice deadline passes unnoticed and the contract renews
cause: Notice date is not in a shared calendar
consequence: A year of cost for software that may no longer be needed
action: Enter every renewal in the next 180 days in renewal-calendar.csv with an owner

risk: A leaver keeps access to a payroll application
cause: Leaver list from HR does not reach the application owner
action: Follow joiner-mover-leaver-procedure.md and compare the leaver list with sign-in logs each month

risk: One person holds all knowledge of the license records
cause: Records sit in one person's files and head
consequence: Records cannot be found if that person is away or leaves
action: Name a backup and move records to the shared location named in source-of-truth-map.csv

risk: Unsupported software stays in use after its vendor ends support
consequence: No security fixes for a product that is still running
action: Retire or replace it using retirement-signoff-checklist.md

risk: A contract term on license transfer is read the wrong way
cause: Transfer clause is silent on acquired companies
consequence: Licenses used by a company that has no right to them
action: Have counsel review the clause and record the answer in contract-terms-check.csv
